tips.text: Hold Spectral Maw a moment before releasing; a longer charge stuns longer and reaches farther. A quick tap is fine to finish a fleeing target.
Cast Blade of the Ruined King on the enemy, then attack right away; your next attack hits twice and heals you.
Use Harrowed Path to hide in the Mist and walk up to a lane unseen. Attacking or casting breaks the camouflage, so open your gank with it.
Fight inside the Mist of Harrowed Path; you attack faster while you stand in it.
Use Heartbreaker on the weakest enemy in a fight. It hits the lowest-health champion, slows them, and knocks back others nearby.
Attack the wraith after a kill to possess the dead enemy. Wait until no enemy can hit you, because you can't act while you wind up.
Damage an enemy before they die so a wraith appears. Take the kill soon after, since the wraith only lasts a short time.
Use Heartbreaker to end a possession early, as it also gives you a free cast of it.

combos.name: Wall Mist ambush
combos.when: When ganking from a brush or wall and you want to stay hidden until the last moment.
combos.text: Cast Harrowed Path at a wall to spread Mist, then stand still in it for camouflage and bonus speed. Charge Spectral Maw from the Mist to start the gank.

tips.text: Hold Spectral Maw a moment before releasing; a longer charge stuns longer and lets you land a clean hit on Aatrox.
Hit Aatrox with an ability first, then attack him; Blade of the Ruined King then strikes twice and heals you.
Aatrox heals a lot when he hits you, so burst him fast instead of dragging out a long trade.
Use Heartbreaker to finish a weakened Aatrox. It targets the lowest-health champion and slows them heavily.
Slip into the Mist from Harrowed Path to hide and reposition before ganking, so Aatrox does not see you coming.
Hold Spectral Maw a moment before you release it; a longer charge stuns longer, so wait until Ambessa is close to land a long stun.
Aim Spectral Maw with care; it stops at the first unit it hits, so a minion in the way soaks it.
Use Harrowed Path to hide in the mist and start fights from camouflage, or to slip away when Ambessa is hunting you.
Open a trade with an ability, then attack. Blade of the Ruined King hits twice and heals you after you damage her with an ability.
Expect Ambessa to dash in on you after an ability. Stun her with Spectral Maw as she closes in.
Save Heartbreaker to finish a hurt Ambessa; it hits harder the more health she is missing.
Stay out of a line with Amumu's Bandage Toss; if he is not stopped he will pull to you and stun you.
Hit Amumu with Spectral Maw first and stun him when he rushes in; a longer charge means a longer stun.
Spread out from your team when Amumu's ultimate is ready, so Curse of the Sad Mummy cannot catch everyone.
Avoid long fights beside Amumu; Despair keeps hurting you, and it is worse for high-health targets.
Use Heartbreaker to escape Amumu's ultimate fight or to finish low-health targets.

comboRefs.note: Camouflage from Harrowed Path hides Viego's approach before Spectral Maw starts the gank on Amumu.

tips.text: Charge Spectral Maw before an all-in so the stun lasts longer, and aim it so it hits Bel'Veth first, not a minion.
Do not fight Bel'Veth for long while she is in Royal Maelstrom; she takes less damage and heals. Wait it out or fight after it ends.
Hide in the Mist from Harrowed Path to approach Bel'Veth unseen, then open with an ability so your next attack strikes twice.
Watch for Above and Below; if it hits you, you are knocked up and slowed, and she gets her dash back to chase you.
Dodge Sear sideways. Brand needs to land something first to start his combo, and a dodged Sear ruins his timing.
Keep minions between you and Brand. Sear ends at the first unit it hits, so a minion in front of you soaks it.
Walk out of Pillar of Flame after it appears. It lands after a short delay, so do not stand still.
Use Spectral Maw to stun Brand when he is close. A longer charge gives a longer stun, but he can dodge it.
Stay away from your allies when Pyroclasm starts. It is slow at first, so you can step away from the group.
Aim Spectral Maw at Briar as she leaps in; it stops at the first enemy it hits and stuns her.
Fight Briar when Chilling Scream is on cooldown; she loses her healing and her knockback stun.
Do not fight near walls when Briar is charging Chilling Scream; a full charge knocks you into them and stuns you.
Use Harrowed Path to hide in the Mist and scout Briar, then strike first with Blade of the Ruined King.
Stay out of Apprehend range and sidestep its cone; getting pulled in starts a fight Darius wins.
Do not fight Darius when he has many Hemorrhage stacks; Noxian Guillotine then hits very hard.
Use Spectral Maw to stun Darius when he is on top of you, then trade with Blade of the Ruined King.
Poke Darius while Apprehend is on cooldown; he cannot catch you easily then.
Hit Diana with Spectral Maw when she dashes at you. A longer charge stuns for longer, which stops her chain of spells.
Dodge Crescent Strike. If you are marked with Moonlight, step away, because Lunar Rush on you comes right back.
Wait out the Pale Cascade shield before you engage Diana. It only lasts a few seconds.
Don't clump with your team near Diana at level 6. Moonfall pulls everyone in and hurts more for each champion caught.
Use Heartbreaker to finish Diana when she is low. It strikes the enemy champion who is hurt the most.
Do not rely on Spectral Maw to stun Mundo the first time; his passive resists it. Hit him once to use it up, then go in.
Step on the canister Mundo drops after resisting your stun so he cannot heal from it.
Dodge Infected Bonesaw; it hurts more the healthier you are and leaves you slowed.
Use Harrowed Path to hide in the Mist and move around Mundo, then pick fights on your terms.
Trade with Blade of the Ruined King, then leave when Mundo uses Heart Zapper, since he stores damage and heals it back.
Burst Mundo as soon as he uses Maximum Dosage, or leave; a long fight lets him heal through your damage.
Charge Spectral Maw a little before releasing it so Ekko is stunned longer. Aim it carefully, because it stops at the first enemy it hits.
Hit Ekko with an ability first, then attack him. Blade of the Ruined King then strikes twice and heals you.
Hold Heartbreaker for a fight where Ekko is low on health. It targets the lowest-health champion, and Ekko's Chronobreak can still pull him away.
Hide in the mist from Harrowed Path before you ambush Ekko. Attacking or casting breaks the camouflage.
Stay away from Evelynn when Allure is marked on you and an arrow points at her; get next to allies or minions before she reaches you.
Hit Evelynn with Spectral Maw when she dashes in; a longer charge stuns her for longer.
Keep your health up against Evelynn; Last Caress does far more damage once you are low.
Use Blade of the Ruined King after an ability so your next attack strikes twice and heals you in a fight.
Place vision on your jungle; Evelynn becomes camouflaged after level 6 and ambushes from the dark.
Break up Fiddlesticks' ambushes by checking brush with your trinket and by watching your own camp for signs of him. His fear works only if you cannot see him.
Spectral Maw is your answer to Fiddlesticks channeling Bountiful Harvest. Hit him with the stun and the channel is interrupted.
Stay out of Reap's center when you can. It slows you and silences you there, so you cannot cast your abilities.
Use Harrowed Path mist to hide and wait. Fiddlesticks is weak if you reach him first, because he has little to protect himself.
Use Heartbreaker when you see Crowstorm start. It ends the channel early and can remove him from the fight.
Charge Spectral Maw longer before releasing it on Graves; a longer charge stuns him longer and reaches farther.
Step out of Smoke Screen quickly; leaving the cloud removes its slow and the vision loss.
Hit Graves with Blade of the Ruined King first, then attack; your next attack strikes twice and heals you.
Use Harrowed Path to hide and approach Graves unseen, but attacking or casting breaks the camouflage.
Hold Heartbreaker until Graves has used Quickdraw; without his dash he struggles to get away.
Charge Spectral Maw a little longer before you release it, and Gwen is stunned for longer. Do not release it into her Hallowed Mist; it blocks the projectile.
Gwen cannot be targeted from outside her Hallowed Mist. Wait for the Mist to end or step inside before you commit.
Use Blade of the Ruined King on Gwen, then attack her right away. The second hit heals you and wins the short trade.
Jump on Gwen before she has attacked a few times. She needs those hits to power up Snip Snip!.
Use Heartbreaker to finish Gwen when she is low on health. She is slowed so she cannot easily get away.
Dodge Hecarim's Devastating Charge or hit him with Spectral Maw as he runs in. Stunning him cancels his burst.
Hecarim heals from Spirit of Dread when you fight next to him, so burst him fast or step out of its range.
Stay spread out from your team when Onslaught of Shadows is up, since its fear is what starts his fights.
Use Harrowed Path to hide in the Mist and scout or reposition. It gives you camouflage if you stop attacking and casting.
Hit Spectral Maw on Ivern when he walks up to a camp; it stuns him, and his friend Daisy can't help while he can't act.
Hold Spectral Maw's charge a little longer before you release it when Ivern is in range; a longer charge means a longer stun.
Hide in the Mist from Harrowed Path before a gank so you can walk up unseen.
Use Heartbreaker to finish a fight when Ivern is the lowest on health; it slows him hard and hits for more as his health drops.
Hit Ivern with an ability, then attack once; Blade of the Ruined King makes that attack strike twice and heals you.
Dodge the line between Jarvan and his Demacian Standard. Stepping out of it avoids the knock up from Dragon Strike.
Charge Spectral Maw before Jarvan closes in. A longer charge stuns him for longer, and the stun gives you time to hit him.
Wait until Jarvan has used Cataclysm before you commit to a fight. Heartbreaker can then get you out of the fight or finish a low-health target.
Use Harrowed Path to hide in its mist and scout for Jarvan. Gain camouflage before he reaches you.
Don't auto-attack Jax while Counter Strike is up. Back off or wait it out, since it dodges your attacks and then stuns you.
Hit Jax with Spectral Maw to stun him before he gets going. A longer charge means a longer stun.
Trade in short bursts instead of long fights. Jax's damage rises the longer he keeps attacking with Relentless Assault.
Use Blade of the Ruined King to damage Jax first, so your next attack hits twice and heals you.
Charge Spectral Maw a bit before you release it. A longer charge stuns longer, and it stops at the first enemy it hits.
Jayce can knock you back with his hammer. Stay away from walls and don't walk straight at him.
Use Harrowed Path to hide in the Mist and surprise Jayce. Attacking or casting breaks the camouflage.
Hit Jayce with an ability first, then attack him. Blade of the Ruined King then strikes twice and heals you.
Use Heartbreaker on Jayce when he is low. It targets the lowest-health champion and slows them heavily.
Hit Karthus with Spectral Maw to stun him, then dive in. It stops at the first enemy, so line it up with no minions in the way.
Use Harrowed Path to stay hidden near Karthus, then strike before he can aim Lay Waste at you.
Don't walk over a Wall of Pain if you can go around; it slows you and cuts your Magic Resist.
Step away from Karthus's corpse after you kill him; he can keep casting Defile and Lay Waste for a few seconds.
Keep your health up from level 6 on, since Requiem reaches you anywhere. Back off when you are low.
Charge Spectral Maw a little before releasing so the stun lasts longer, and aim at Kayn when he commits to a fight.
Stun Kayn with Spectral Maw when he goes into terrain with Shadow Step; hard crowd control ends it immediately.
Stay out of Blade's Reach range when you can; it slows you and lets Kayn follow with Umbral Trespass.
Use Harrowed Path to hide in the mist and reposition before fights; Kayn may lose track of you.
Stay near your minions or allies so Kha'Zix cannot get the extra damage from Taste Their Fear on an isolated target.
Fight Kha'Zix once Leap and Void Assault are on cooldown; he has little way to escape or engage then.
Hold Spectral Maw until Kha'Zix is close, then charge it to stun him; he cannot easily dodge a stun at close range.
Use Harrowed Path to hide in its mist and wait for Kha'Zix to walk by. Attack him first when he comes close.
Aim Spectral Maw at Kindred when she has no dash ready; the stun lets you catch someone who is fragile.
Do not chase Kindred while she has Dance of Arrows ready. She can dash away and hit you.
Stay out of Lamb's Respite when you try to kill. No one inside can die, so finish elsewhere or wait for it to end.
Use Harrowed Path in the jungle to hide and move closer to Kindred before you jump on her.
Hold Spectral Maw for when Lee Sin dashes in or lines up. A longer charge stuns longer, but he can see you winding up.
Lee Sin's Dragon's Rage knocks you back and you can't act until it lands. Spread out from your teammates so they don't get hit when you are kicked into them.
Use Harrowed Path to hide in the Mist and make Lee Sin lose track of you before he ganks. Attacking breaks the camouflage.
After Lee Sin hits Tempest, he can slow you with Cripple. Don't run straight away, fight back with Blade of the Ruined King.
Charge Spectral Maw a little before releasing it so the stun lasts longer, and aim it at Lillia when she hops in with Watch Out! Eep!.
Spectral Maw can be blocked by the first unit it hits, so line it up on Lillia with no other target in front.
Lillia is hard to catch once her Blooming Blows stacks build up. Stun her with Spectral Maw first, then use Blade of the Ruined King to finish the fight.
Use Heartbreaker to start a fight on a low-health Lillia. It also knocks back her allies and ends any Possession, so cast it only when you want that.
Stay out of Lilting Lullaby's reach when she has marked you with Dream Dust. Being stunned or killed first wins the fight.
Sidestep Swirlseed; it keeps rolling until it hits someone or a wall, so the slow is easy to dodge by moving off its line.
Walk out of the center of Lillia's big strike as it winds up, since the middle hurts far more than the edge.
Charge Spectral Maw to stun Master Yi when he jumps in; Highlander does not stop stuns.
Do not rely on slowing him once Highlander is on, because he ignores slows. Use stuns or knock backs instead.
Save Heartbreaker for when Master Yi is hurt; it goes for the enemy who is lowest on Health. His Meditate heal can undo your damage, so burst him through it.
Use Harrowed Path to hide and gain Attack Speed while you wait near Master Yi's camps.
Chase him when Alpha Strike is on cooldown, since he cannot escape or dodge your abilities then.
Aim Spectral Maw at Wukong when he dashes in with Nimbus Strike. It stuns the first enemy it hits, which may be a clone, so wait for the real one.
Wait a moment after Wukong uses Warrior Trickster before you commit spells, so you hit the real Wukong and not his clone.
Fight Wukong away from your own allies. He gets tougher with each hit he lands, so keep fights short and avoid long brawls with him.
Stay away from Wukong when Cyclone is ready, because it knocks you up. Use Harrowed Path to reposition before he can reach you.
Hold Spectral Maw a moment before releasing it so the stun lasts longer. It stops at the first enemy hit, so line it up.
Hit Naafiri with an ability first, then attack her; Blade of the Ruined King strikes twice and heals you in the extended fight.
Wait for Naafiri to commit Hounds' Pursuit or Eviscerate, then fight her; she is easier to catch with her dash on cooldown.
Use Harrowed Path to hide in the mist and walk up on Naafiri for a surprise fight, or to slip away when she jumps you.
Save Heartbreaker for when Naafiri is low on health; it picks the lowest-health enemy and slows them, so she can't run.
If you kill Naafiri, attack the wraith that appears to possess her; you get her abilities and a heal.
Dodge Nidalee's Javelin Toss when she is far away; it hurts most from range. Step sideways, because it stops at the first enemy it hits.
Aim Spectral Maw at Nidalee when she Pounces in; a charged shot stuns her for longer. Stunned, she can't chase or flee.
Hold your Spectral Maw for when Nidalee goes in for the kill. Takedown does huge damage to Hunted targets, and a stun cuts it off.
Walk around brush and unseen ground carefully, since Bushwhack traps are invisible once armed. Don't path through spots where Nidalee has been standing.

comboRefs.note: Camouflage from Harrowed Path hides his gank start, though Nidalee's Bushwhack traps can still catch him.

tips.text: Do not stun Nocturne with Spectral Maw while his Shroud of Darkness is up; it blocks the spell. Wait for it to fade.
Step away from Nocturne when he casts Unspeakable Horror. Getting out of range breaks the tether before the fear.
Stay near your team once Nocturne casts Paranoia. He can dash to any champion, and you cannot see far.
Use Harrowed Path to hide in the Mist. Nocturne's Duskbringer trail is not blocked by it, so watch for his trail.
Stun Nunu with Spectral Maw if he is close, and sidestep sharply to dodge Biggest Snowball Ever!
Step out of Snowball Barrage's snowballs, or move away before the root lands.
Do not stand in Absolute Zero for its full length. Leave its area or interrupt it with a stun from Spectral Maw.
Charge Spectral Maw before you release it; a longer charge stuns Pantheon for longer, but he can hit you while you charge.
Do not fight Pantheon head-on while Aegis Assault is up; step to his side or wait until it ends.
Stay healthy near Pantheon; his thrown Comet Spear hits hard against low Health enemies.
Leave when you see Grand Starfall's warning; Heartbreaker can escape his landing or catch an enemy low on Health afterward.
Hold Spectral Maw a moment before releasing it; a longer charge stuns Qiyana for longer, and she is easy to kill while stunned.
Use Harrowed Path to hide in the Mist and approach unseen, then start the fight with an attack or Spectral Maw.
Spectral Maw ends on the first enemy it hits, so aim it so a minion does not catch it before Qiyana.
Hit Qiyana with an ability, then attack her; Blade of the Ruined King strikes twice and heals you.
Qiyana is fragile, so Heartbreaker can finish her when she is the lowest-health enemy; she is slowed and cannot easily run.
Don't fight Rammus while Defensive Ball Curl is up; his armor is huge and your attacks hurt you through it.
Trade when Defensive Ball Curl is down; Rammus is much weaker without it.
Hit Rammus with Spectral Maw as he rolls in; the stun stops him from reaching you.
Stay away from Rammus when Frenzying Taunt is ready; being taunted in a fight is deadly for you.
Hit Rek'Sai with Spectral Maw and hold the charge a little longer to stun her longer. Follow up with Blade of the Ruined King while she is stunned.
Hit her with an ability first, then attack, so Blade of the Ruined King strikes twice and heals you in a long fight.
Use Harrowed Path to hide in the Mist and reposition. Attacking or casting breaks the camouflage, so wait for a good moment to jump her.
Be careful when her Fury is full, because her bite then deals extra damage. Fight a little earlier or later than that.
Do not walk away when Rek'Sai marks you. Void Rush can't be stopped, so stay near your team instead of running alone.
Stun Rengar with Spectral Maw when he leaps out of brush; a longer charge means a longer stun.
Avoid fighting Rengar near brush, since his leap closes the gap instantly and starts his Ferocity.
Expect Rengar to ambush you when he is at full Ferocity; his empowered Bola Strike roots you, so keep distance.
Stay with your team when Rengar uses Thrill of the Hunt; a marker shows above the champion he is closing on.
Hit Rengar with Blade of the Ruined King after a Spectral Maw to get the second strike and heal.
Step out of the way of Glacial Prison. Its long range and heavy stun are the biggest danger to you in a fight.
Hold Spectral Maw until Sejuani commits with Arctic Assault, then stun her. Her charge ends on the first champion it hits.
Stay away from Sejuani and her melee allies when you fight. Their attacks build up Frost, and then Permafrost stuns you.
Dodge the second swing of Winter's Wrath, which hits hardest and slows you.
Walk around bushes and camp entrances carefully. Shaco's Jack In The Box is invisible, and it will fear and root you.
Hit Shaco with Spectral Maw when he appears from Deceive. It stuns the first enemy it hits, and a full charge stuns for longer.
Stay with your team when Shaco is around. He wants to hit you from behind, so face him and do not fight alone.
Hold Spectral Maw charged to stun Shyvana as she runs at you; a longer charge stuns for longer.
Hit Shyvana with an ability, then attack. Blade of the Ruined King strikes twice and heals you in a long fight.
Hide in Harrowed Path's mist to ambush or to escape. Attacking or casting breaks the camouflage.
Keep your distance and poke Shyvana while her Dragon Fury is low. She is weak when she cannot attack you.
Use Heartbreaker to finish off a weakened Shyvana; it picks the lowest-health enemy and slows them.
Aim Spectral Maw at Skarner as he charges at you. Its stun stops him from carrying you into a wall.
Don't fight with your back to a wall when Skarner is near. Ixtal's Impact can slam you into it.
Step out of Impale's line or use Flash before it lands. It can be dodged.
Don't ignore Skarner's steady damage. Break off from long fights once Quaking has built up on you.
Hold Spectral Maw until Sylas commits, then charge it before releasing; a longer charge stuns him for longer and sets up your attacks.
Hit Sylas with an ability, then attack him right away; Blade of the Ruined King makes that attack strike twice and heal you.
Sylas heals more from Kingslayer when he is low, so finish him fast and do not let a low-health Sylas walk away.
Stay hidden in Harrowed Path mist before a gank; you are camouflaged until you attack or cast.
Use Heartbreaker when Sylas is the most wounded enemy nearby; it goes for the enemy who is lowest on health.
Hit Talon with Spectral Maw when he leaps in. The stun stops his combo, and a longer charge means a longer stun.
Talon can vanish with Shadow Assault. Stay close to your team and don't chase him alone while it's available.
Hide in the Mist from Harrowed Path to ambush Talon. Stay out of his Rake range, since it slows you.
Avoid fighting on Trundle's Frozen Domain; he is much faster and hits much harder there. Pull the fight off the ice.
Leave Pillar of Ice quickly; it slows you, and Trundle uses it to cut off your escape.
Charge Spectral Maw before Trundle reaches you so you can stun him. Longer charge, longer stun.
Use Harrowed Path to hide, then jump the fight with the extra Attack Speed. Trundle cannot target you while you are camouflaged.
Trundle heals when enemies die near him, so do not fight beside minions or a dead champion that gives him that health.
Keep your distance from Udyr; he has few ranged options, so poke with Spectral Maw and Blade of the Ruined King instead of trading up close.
Don't let Udyr's Blazing Stampede attack land on you; fight him where you can see him coming and sidestep the dash.
Fight Udyr when his Awaken is spent; after an Awakened ability he can't Awaken others for a while.
Hit Udyr with an ability first, then attack, so Blade of the Ruined King strikes twice and heals you.
Hold Spectral Maw a moment before you release it; a longer charge stuns longer, so Vi has less time to get away or fight back.
Do not rely on dodging Cease and Desist by moving. Vi cannot be stopped mid-dash, so use your untargetable moment or stay near allies.
Break up long brawls: Vi gets faster and shreds your Armor once she lands a third hit on you.
Use Harrowed Path to hide in the mist before a gank. Attacking or casting breaks the camouflage, so close in without hitting first.
Use Heartbreaker to finish a weakened Vi; it targets the enemy with the lowest health left and leaves them slowed.
Charge Spectral Maw a little before releasing it on Volibear; it stuns longer, but he can still dive in fast.
Stay out of Volibear's reach when his Thundering Smash is ready. It speeds him toward you and stuns on his next Attack.
Use Harrowed Path to hide and reposition in its Mist before a fight; you gain Attack Speed inside it.
Hit Volibear with an ability, then attack him; Blade of the Ruined King strikes a second time and heals you.
Use Heartbreaker on a low-health Volibear. Expect him to get tougher if he has used Stormbringer.
Stay out of Warwick's reach when he holds Jaws of the Beast; dashing away will not shake him off.
Aim Spectral Maw at Warwick as he closes in. The stun gives you time to trade or get away.
Keep your health up; Warwick tracks you once you are low and hits much faster.
Use Harrowed Path to hide in the mist and break Warwick's chase. Attacking or casting spoils the camouflage.
Warwick heals when he is low, so save your stun to finish him instead of spending it early.
Charge Spectral Maw longer for a longer stun, but release it before Xin Zhao reaches you. The stun is the best way to stop his combo.
Stay out of the enemy's reach. Xin Zhao's third Three Talon Strike hit knocks you up, so back away or stun him before he finishes it.
Use Harrowed Path to hide in the Mist and gain Attack Speed. Fight inside it when Xin Zhao comes at you.
Use Heartbreaker to finish a weak Xin Zhao. It picks the enemy champion who is lowest on health.
Stay out of Zac's Elastic Slingshot range when you hear him charging. Spectral Maw stuns him and cancels his leap if you land it first.
Step on Zac's goo chunks to destroy them. That stops him healing from them in a long trade.
Zac's Stretching Strikes slows you and ties you to him for a short time. Break away from him before he can hit you with a second strike.
Kill every one of Zac's bloblets when Cell Division triggers, or he comes back. Your Heartbreaker can also help catch them.
Use Harrowed Path to hide in the mist and avoid Zac's stretching strikes when you are about to be attacked.
Hold Spectral Maw until Zed commits to a dash or a Death Mark; the stun can stop him in the middle of his combo.
Charge Spectral Maw a little longer when you can; a longer charge stuns for longer and reaches further.
Use a damaging ability first, then attack, so Blade of the Ruined King hits twice and heals you in a short fight.
Zed's Shadow Slash slows you only when a shadow hits you, so fight the real Zed, not his shadows.
If you kill Zed within a few seconds of damaging him, attack the wraith to heal and take his body, but only when no enemies are near.
Use Harrowed Path to hide in the mist and wait for Zed to walk past, then start the fight with Spectral Maw.
Step around seeds Zyra plants; walking on them destroys them and reveals you.
Dodge Grasping Roots before you dash in; it roots you and you can't reach her.
Aim Spectral Maw at Zyra to stun her; she is fragile once she is caught.
Fight away from her plants, which expire quickly. Kill Zyra first with Heartbreaker if she is low.
Leave the area of Stranglethorns before it snaps up; you can't act while knocked up.
